content.short: Airswift enables decentralized crypto payments for businesses and consumers worldwide.
content.description: Airswift runs a decentralized payment gateway that lets businesses worldwide accept crypto payments by transferring digital assets through blockchain smart contracts without intermediaries. It leverages a liquidity pool to support Web3 payments, which can reduce transaction fees and open a potential investment opportunity. By combining decentralization with VC/DID and ZK-proof standards, merchants cut custodian risk while enhancing privacy. E-commerce merchants can access Airswift's gateway via a plugin or API.
content.meta: Airswift offers a decentralized crypto payment gateway for businesses to accept assets. Discover Airswift and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
